basic_info.description: Rarely available unit with extra-large windows and Breathtaking OCEAN VIEWS!! Immerse yourself in oceanfront living from this beautifully updated 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom condo located along San Francisco's iconic Ocean Beach shoreline. This light-filled unit features an expansive open floor plan with STUNNING ocean views, a decorative fireplace, and a private balcony perfect for enjoying unobstructed ocean views and delightful coastal breezes. The chef's kitchen is outfitted with recently updated stainless steel appliances, granite countertops, and custom white cabinetry.   The spacious primary suite offers a large walk-in closet, a walk-out balcony with direct ocean views, and an updated ensuite bath.  The second bedroom also includes a walk-in closet. An updated guest bathroom with shower-over-tub and a laundry closet with newer washer/dryer add to the home's thoughtful amenities. Additional features include one car garage parking, private storage, and access to premium building amenities such as an updated fitness center, community room, bike storage, onsite property manager and lush outdoor courtyards with seating areas.    Enjoy peaceful coastal living just moments from Golden Gate Park, Ocean Beach, Safeway, and convenient public transportation.
